lifecycle.not_connected: no alternate Host/project/Engine or automatic retry; return concrete transport/NoActiveProject condition
lifecycle.admission: seven long actions return TaskHandle. Business result is get_task.result from matching originating_operation, not initial Ok
lifecycle.disconnect_before_reply: edit/run admission may be ambiguous; preserve local proposal/last confirmed repair count and stop automatic work. Do not resend request_id as an idempotency token. Accepted tasks remain Host-owned
lifecycle.reconnect: fresh authenticated connection and explicit actual Host scope; old file tokens and handles do not restore authority. Read existing known TaskId after reauthorization; unknown admission requires Host/user reconciliation, not a fabricated ID
lifecycle.cancel_request: outstanding MCP request may use notifications/cancelled; after TaskHandle call business cancel_task action=cancel and then get_task. Optional MCP Tasks extension not assumed
lifecycle.terminal_race: Completed wins after real output/commit; CancelRequested remains pending; Failed/Cancelled preserve supported known prefix only
lifecycle.view_controls: UI playback pause/seek does not change compute task; pause_calculation/resume_calculation/step_next_timestamp only from actual allowed_controls
lifecycle.switch_close: real task terminal/dirty decision then revoke old connection/project grants; delayed result stays on originating scope and cannot overwrite new current view
lifecycle.disconnect_image_leases: close connection-owned image handles without business cancel; already admitted work remains Host-owned; no resubmit or second Engine. Business continuation is modeled here, not actual Host execution.

managed_json_return.authority_ref: docs/03_架构与契约/大结果传输设计.md
managed_json_return.selection: Host captures the complete original Response<R> at the same state boundary, releases business lock, and selects managed only when complete UTF8 IPC frame including attachments exceeds cap. No truncation or synthetic pagination.
managed_json_return.file_payload: Immutable full original Response<R>; outcome ok/error only, no nested managed. response_schema_ref is the original operation catalog type identifier, never a caller-selected path.
managed_json_return.OS_read: Host authenticates actual pipe peer and scope, opens a fresh GENERIC_READ file at offset0 per response, then non-inherited DuplicateHandle to actual bridge PID. Only the authenticated, known owned lease may be read/closed.
before_read: Exactly one matching result_id; handle_value equals trusted ownership record
response_schema_ref equals original operation response_schema_ref; outer request_id/context match authorized request
Native file size equals exact declared byte_length
after_read: Read exactly byte_length and actual EOF
Parse full corresponding Response<R> schema; prohibit recursive managed
For get_run ok response also match requested RunId, frozen input_ref and computed frontier; original error requires no invented Run
managed_json_return.MCP: Keep small typed outer Response in structuredContent; include full original Response as application/json EmbeddedResource text at superfactory-result://<result_id>. Embedded text is immediately usable; do not return only a link or invent resources/read.
managed_json_return.error_semantics: Derive MCP isError from recovered original outcome.error, never from outer managed status alone. A valid managed PermissionDenied remains an error; it cannot be treated as successful business admission or retried as a new request.
managed_json_return.failure_cleanup: Wrong identity/type/nested outcome/read/length/parse failure emits no partial or successful resource. Report concrete MCP transport/tool failure using existing operation error semantics; do not forge a Host ApiError response. Always close only the known owned lease. Transfer cancellation closes lease but creates no TaskId or business Cancelled result; no automatic resubmit, no Run mutation.
managed_json_return.post_unwrap_image: Only after full typed get_task response is recovered, validate existing managed_assets against the original completed render Task/Asset/Scope/requested and scene revision. JSON capability never grants image/path authority.
